title: Wine Tasting Note Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: CellarTracker bottles (`cellartracker:bottle`), Vivino wines (`vivino:wine`), spirits bottles (`spirit:bottle`), and wine tasting notes (`wine:tasting`).
app: CellarTracker bottle exports, Vivino wine scans, spirits inventory logs, and tasting note journals forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wine:tasting
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by tasting_type
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when wine tasting note data has stopped arriving for a given tasting type.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per tasting type and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers when one part of your wine tasting note feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
